scene: You cross over to a round treehouse bustling with flying messenger pigeons.
picture: Side view of a round wooden treehouse floor. Far left, a speckled pigeon sits on a roost above a crate of berries. Left, a wooden message board hangs on the bark wall. Centre, the dark-haired boy stands holding his skateboard. Right, a polished brass parcel chute curves downward through the wooden floor.
shown: a plump speckled pigeon roosting calmly on a perch on the far left
a wooden message board tacked with colourful paper notes on the left
a curving brass parcel chute open and gleaming on the right
